command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Analytical two-cell energy equations with unequal widths, conductivity, heat capacity and bulk exchange. Contact conductance g=0.5/(0.125+0.25+0.375/3) W/K. Diagonal terms are g+H*V+i*omega*C*V, cross terms -g, and loads V*(source+H*Ta). Invert the two-by-two system and compare cell temperatures, individual powers, contact transfer and local balance at three frequencies. A separate floating case checks uniform storage contributions at 1e-16 rad/s.
